title: What they said at the time

clips.q: Some of the early products just didn’t measure up, and we were never able to recover.
clips.who: **Morton E. Handel**, Coleco executive vice president, on the Adam, January 1985[^4]

clips.q: That’s the nature of the toy industry. It’s boom or bust.
clips.who: **Gary Jacobson**, toy analyst, Kidder, Peabody & Co., on the bankruptcy, July 1988[^8]

clips.q: Coleco always stood for innovation and the ability to take risks. The industry is poorer because of their demise.
clips.who: **Paul Valentine**, toy analyst, Standard & Poor’s, June 1989[^11]
